title: Thomas Edison
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor. In 1879 he made a practical light bulb. He had over a thousand patents in his life. He worked in a laboratory in New Jersey.

Edison was very curious. He liked to test new ideas every day, even when his experiments failed. Many people still use his inventions today. His work changed the way people lived.

options: In a laboratory in New Jersey

questions.text: What did Edison like to do every day?
Why is Edison's work still important today?
options: His inventions are still used by many people

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Edison's personality?
options: He was afraid of new ideas

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison fue un inventor famoso. En 1879 creó una bombilla práctica. Tuvo más de mil patentes a lo largo de su vida. Trabajaba en un laboratorio de Nueva Jersey.

Edison era muy curioso. Le gustaba probar nuevas ideas todos los días, incluso cuando sus experimentos fracasaban. Muchas personas todavía usan sus inventos hoy en día. Su trabajo cambió la forma en que la gente vivía.
